title: Conditional random forest separates active from latent tuberculosis infection
summary: A cforest model on routine laboratory, T-SPOT and lymphocyte data from 892 participants (468 active, 424 latent) reached training AUC 0.995. In an independent hospital cohort of 263 participants it gave sensitivity 92.8% and specificity 89.9%. The two-center retrospective data come from China only.
ai_technology: Conditional random forest (cforest) on laboratory and T-SPOT data
organization: Tongji Hospital; Huazhong University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: Independent validation cohort of 263 participants (125 active, 138 latent).
